requirement: Joomla page.create gives the new page's menu item the template style the site's own article pages wear, and a page whose words do not show is never reported as shown

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: dskeepjo (tracy-base j6, T4), 10/10/2026: 'Tạo thêm một trang Dịch vụ có ba mục … và thêm trang này vào menu chính' made menu item 347 with template_style_id 0; Joomla rendered /dich-vu in the default style 110 'Tracy — base · Home' (body class layout-home, no itemprop=articleBody, none of the article's words), while the call reported 'shown on /dich-vu' because the new menu link carries the title.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0'. 'Joomla: the menu item wears the style the site’s article pages wear, never a default home layout that prints no article' is ok: on a site whose DEFAULT style is a home layout (no component), the new menu item is written with template_style_id 14 (the style About us and Contact wear, the home page skipped), the page renders its article body, and verified is ['shown on /en/common-questions', 'its menu link shows on /en/ at desktop 1440 and phone 390'] (the menu line since REG-PR-1100-p4-wp-menu-link-visible). 'Joomla: a page whose words do not show is never "shown" on its menu link, and the receipt does not call it live' is ok: when every article page wears the default, no template_style_id is written, verified[0] is the bodyHidden sentence (not 'shown on'), and next is the receiptHidden sentence, without the word 'live'.
